name: io.github.atalanta0505/fairyreport-mcp
description: Local-first structured consulting & engineering report MCP server: 15 authoritative report blueprints, 3-source RAG (local materials + standards + web), cross-chapter numerical consistency verification, and publication-grade three-line-table DOCX export.

environment_variables.name: ENGINE_DATA_DIR
environment_variables.description: Optional local directory for storing project materials, vector indexes, and exported DOCX reports (defaults to ./data).

environment_variables.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Optional LLM API key if using the autonomous engine chapter drafting tool; not required for the 6 core Host-LLM tools.
